edges.reason: mintDoggos loops and calls mintInternal for each requested token
mintInternal calls hash() to generate the token trait hash
mintInternal executes the isContract(msg.sender) guard
_totalSupply is read from totalSupply() inside mintInternal
thisTokenId is assigned from the cached total supply during minting
hash calls rarityGen to convert each random input to a trait index
rarityGen return value is appended to currentHash inside hash
currentHash accumulates rarityGen results across loop iterations
_randinput is computed from keccak randomness inside hash
_randinput is passed as the first argument to rarityGen
currentLowerBound accumulates tier percentages in rarityGen
tokenURI calls hashToSVG to render the image
tokenURI calls hashToMetadata to render attributes
tokenURI reads the token hash through _tokenIdToHash
tokenURI consumes the requested token id parameter
tokenHash is loaded from tokenIdToHash storage inside _tokenIdToHash
hashToSVG parses the supplied hash string
hashToMetadata parses the supplied hash string
withdraw performs the ETH payout to msg.sender
balance is read from address(this).balance before the transfer
the captured balance is forwarded in the external transfer
msg.sender is the ETH payout recipient in withdraw
msg.sender is passed to the extcodesize isContract check
msg.sender becomes the mint recipient inside mintInternal
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with the stored owner in withdraw
onlyOwner restricts addTraitType by msg.sender
onlyOwner restricts clearTraits by msg.sender
_owner is read by owner() for the onlyOwner check on withdraw
block.timestamp is used as an entropy source for trait randomness
block.timestamp is hashed inside hash() to derive pseudo-random values
SEED_NONCE is incremented and included in the hash preimage
hashToMinted is consulted to reject duplicate hashes
price is multiplied by _times to validate msg.value
_times drives the payment multiplication and mint loop count
MAX_SUPPLY bounds the supply check in mintInternal
tokenIdToHash is written during mintInternal
tokenIdToHash is read by _tokenIdToHash
traitTypes pixels are read while building the SVG
traitTypes names and types are read while building metadata
addTraitType pushes new entries into traitTypes
clearTraits deletes entries from traitTypes
_traitTypeIndex selects which traitTypes array is appended
traits array supplies the values copied into traitTypes
_t is part of the hash preimage
_a is part of the hash preimage
_c is validated and included in the hash preimage and recursion
_randinput is compared against cumulative tier boundaries
_rarityTier selects the TIERS row used for the lookup

normalization_plan.reason: Loop count and payment multiplier parameter belongs to mintDoggos
Cached supply value is local to mintInternal
Newly derived token id is local to mintInternal
Token id seed parameter belongs to hash()
Address seed parameter belongs to hash()
Collision nonce parameter belongs to hash()
Accumulating hash string is local to hash()
Derived random value is local to hash()
Rarity lookup input belongs to rarityGen()
Tier selector parameter belongs to rarityGen()
Cumulative bound is local to rarityGen()
Trait index parameter belongs to addTraitType()
Trait array parameter belongs to addTraitType()
Requested token id belongs to tokenURI()
Loaded hash value is local to _tokenIdToHash()
Rendered hash parameter belongs to the SVG/metadata renderers
Captured balance is consumed by the ETH transfer operation
